answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie reputation to costly, verifiable work rather than free identities: each agent earns trust only by completing attested tasks over time, so a flood of fresh accounts starts at the ledge with no standing. Staked deposits that burn on proven fraud keep the ember of abuse expensive, while long-lived, consistently honest agents rise toward the zenith of trust and gain cheaper access. Identity becomes earned history, not a checkbox.
